title: Photonic chips adopted faster than expected: Discover -> plans

input.event: Photonic chips are being adopted faster than expected

expected.behavior: Return 1-3 candidates, each with one of the three evidence labels; Inspect the first grounded candidate. Within that direction, branch only where there is a real dispute (one branch is fine if there is none); one plan per terminal. At least one numeric condition, with a threshold grounded in the pack or null plus threshold_note. Address the counter-evidence in the pack (sc-036 ramp timing, sc-025 laser count, sc-043 integrated-laser route): either mark the claim contradicted or explain why it is not a rebuttal.
expected.key_excerpts_note: Ids from the real Semiconductor Pack (packs/semiconductor.json), checked against the text: CPO ramp pulled forward sc-033, sc-035; timing counter-evidence sc-036 (volume ramp in 2027-2028); light-source demand sc-039 (Lumentum's first ELS order); counter-evidence sc-025 (ELS cuts total lasers to 1/4) and sc-043 (integrated-laser route, currently pluggable / LPO, not CPO). The pack has no direct evidence that integrated lasers replace CPO external light sources and no official silicon-photonics foundry utilization; the model should mark those unverified / model_only, not invent them.

human_review: E1: does the cited text support each edge's mechanism
E2: if this numeric condition were removed, would the thesis still stand
Branch quality: are the branches real competitors, not padding
